name: adv_domain_gas_vs_oil_rejected
source:
// The domain$ family separation: pneumatic (domain$=gas) meeting hydraulic
// (domain$=oil) on the shared (P, mdot, h) bond must be a hard error.
PneumaticSupply  PS(g1, fluid$ = Air, P = 500000, T = 300)
HydraulicOrifice HO(o1, o2, CdA = 1e-5, rho = 870, model$ = turbulent)
HydraulicTank    TK(o2, P = 100000)
connect(PS.out, HO.in)
p = HO.in.P

error.message: connect(ps.out, ho.in): cannot connect a 'gas' line (ps.out) to a 'oil' line (ho.in). Thermofluid ('fluid'), liquid ('liquid'), two-phase ('twophase'), pneumatic ('gas'), hydraulic ('oil') and humid-air ('moistair') are incompatible fluid connector types; couple them only through a heat exchanger.
